subject: Foundry Labs cohort: graduation credits & tier smoothing
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@orbitlabs.ai>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Foundry cohort graduation — credits and smoothing ask

Hi Aisha / Laura,

Quick note from Foundry Labs — our current accelerator cohort is graduating next week and usage spiked unexpectedly during demo prep. We still have some promo credits in the account but the team is worried about a cliff when the credits expire.

Two quick asks: 1) Can Redwood convert the remaining promo credit pool into a discounted committed tier for the first 3 months post-graduation? 2) If not, is there a one-time smoothing/top-up you can apply to avoid immediate overage during demo week?

Attaching a short usage summary for the cohort (overview numbers). Happy to jump on a call.

Thanks — Samir
Samir Patel
Program Lead, Foundry Labs
samir@orbitlabs.ai
[Attachment: Foundry_Graduation_Usage_Report.pdf (pdf, 142KB)]

From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@orbitlabs.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Foundry cohort graduation — credits and smoothing ask

Hi Samir — thanks for the heads up and for the usage report.

High level — we can offer two pragmatic paths:
- Short-term smoothing: a one-time top-up (promo credit extension) to cover demo week (up to X tokens) while you finalize post-graduation plans.
- Bridge discount + conversion: convert the remaining promo pool into a time-limited discount applied to a short committed tier (e.g., 30% off for 3 months) if Foundry signs a 6-month bridge commitment. This protects you from cliffs and gives us a clearer billing path.

I attached a proposed tier-smoothing workbook with example numbers (sizing, estimated spend, and invoice timing). Can you confirm the cohort's expected month-1 consumption if we applied the smoothing option? If you prefer the conversion + discount path, we'll need a quick MSA addendum (Ben/Laura can pick that up).

Proposed next steps:
- Samir: confirm which path you prefer and month-1 estimate by Friday.
- Ben: if conversion, draft addendum and invoice terms.
- Laura: confirm finance feasibility for promo-to-discount conversion.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[aisha@redwood.com]
[Attachment: Proposed_Tier_Smoothing.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)]

From: Samir Patel <samir@orbitlabs.ai>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: Janelle Ortiz <janelle@foundryvc.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Foundry cohort graduation — credits and smoothing ask

Thanks Aisha — attaching the cohort's detailed usage export (per-project). We pulled the month-1 projection based on recent runs: ~1.1M tokens across three teams (peak day ~250k).

We'd prefer the conversion + discount route if Redwood can make the discount front-loaded (stronger in month 1 and tapering months 2–3) because a lot of the heavy infra is during demo week. If that's possible, we'll confirm formally.

Also: would Redwood consider a small one-time demo-week top-up in addition to the conversion? It would smooth the handoff while contracts are executed.

Appreciate the help — Samir
[Attachment: Foundry_Graduation_Usage_Report.pdf (detailed, 1.2MB)]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@orbitlabs.ai>, aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, billing@foundryvc.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Foundry cohort graduation — credits and smoothing ask

Hi Samir / Aisha,

Finance here — quick guidance on options we can approve without exec escalation:

1) Demo-week top-up: we can issue a one-time promo extension equivalent to ~200k tokens to cover immediate overage. This is a discretionary gesture and will be applied as account-level promo balance; it will not change invoicing cadence.

2) Promo -> discount conversion: feasible if Foundry signs a short addendum committing to a 6-month bridge (minimum monthly spend to be negotiated). Proposal: 30% off for month 1, 20% off for month 2, 10% off for month 3 applied to Redwood API usage, then standard pricing thereafter. Any leftover promo balance can be rolled into the first invoice as a credit.

3) Invoicing: we'll invoice monthly in arrears. If Foundry wants prepaid billing, Ben can prepare a prepaid quote and map the promos accordingly.

If this sounds acceptable, please confirm and Ben will prepare the addendum + invoice terms and I will route the temporary promo for demo week once we get confirmation.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
[Attachment: none]

From: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@orbitlabs.ai>, Janelle Ortiz <janelle@foundryvc.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Foundry cohort graduation — credits and smoothing ask

Thanks everyone — quick summary and actions so we can close this week:

- Foundry preference: conversion + discount with front-loaded month-1 protection (per Samir).
- Finance approved conditional path: 30% / 20% / 10% taper over first three months, with a 6-month bridge commitment.
- Laura to issue one-time demo-week top-up (200k tokens) once Samir confirms the conversion path.
- Ben to draft the addendum and prepaid invoice mapping (Ben: target EOD Thu).
- Samir to confirm month-1 estimate (you indicated ~1.1M tokens) and sign the addendum so we can apply the credit roll and start the discount.

Samir — if you confirm here, I will trigger Laura for the demo top-up immediately and Ben will send the addendum link (DocuSign). Happy to get on a 20-minute call if helpful.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aisha@redwood.com
[Attachment: Proposed_Tier_Smoothing.xlsx (xlsx, 24KB)]
